        inf = len(source) + 1
        dp = [inf] * (m + 1)

        # embedding of pattern[:j] in the source prefix processed so far.
        for i, ch in enumerate(source):
            cost = int(i in target)
            for j in range(m - 1, -1, -1):
                if ch == pattern[j] and dp[j] != inf:
                    dp[j + 1] = min(dp[j + 1], dp[j] + cost)

        # Of all target positions, every one outside a minimum-cost embedding
        # can be removed while preserving the pattern.
        return len(targetIndices) - dp[m]
